_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for every third-party (vendored-git) skill: repo, pinned ref, subpath, prune list, frontmatter overrides and body patches applied at vendor time.
_meta.schema: flat: <skill-name> -> {repo, ref, subpath, prune?, frontmatter_overrides?, prepend_body?, patches?:[{file,find,replace}], notes?}. ref = tag or FULL commit sha. frontmatter_overrides: add/replace keys, null deletes, metadata deep-merged. patches are literal find/replace and must match.
_meta.provenance: build_provenance.py reads this file + skills/<name>/.vendored.json; R10 hashes the patched result.
_meta.rules: Never run upstream install scripts that write settings; never start dev servers; the reticle MCP server is registered separately (installer manifest, pinned, RETICLE_TELEMETRY=0).

verify-ui-change.prepend_body: > **Local guard (vendor patch, ~/.claude):** attach only to the app the user already runs. patches.find: Run `RETICLE_INSTALL_SOURCE=npx_skill npx @reticlehq/server@latest init`, then keep going without the tools: fix every `⚠` it printed, start the project's own dev script in the background if nothing is serving the app, and open it with `npx @reticlehq/server open <the url the dev server is serving>`.
